```sql
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2010 THEN COALESCE(ps.points, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2009 THEN COALESCE(ps.points, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS points_diff
FROM main."results" r
JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN main."drivers" d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
LEFT JOIN main."points_scheme" ps ON 
    r."positionOrder" = ps."position" 
    AND ps."scheme_id" = (
        SELECT "scheme_id" 
        FROM main."points_scheme" 
        WHERE "authored" = true 
        ORDER BY "scheme_id" 
        LIMIT 1
    )
WHERE LOWER(d."surname") = 'button' 
    AND ra."year" IN (2009, 2010)
    AND ra."date" <= '2011-03-01';
```
